## User Stories

### Implement Report Header Display
- **Story:** As a user, I want to see the report header with date and sample size so that I can understand the context of the report data
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Report date is displayed in YYYY-MM-DD format
  - [ ] Number of workflow runs sampled is clearly shown
  - [ ] Header has consistent styling with the rest of the report
  - [ ] Header is positioned at the top of the report
  - [ ] Date and sample size are properly formatted and aligned

### Create ReportHeader Component
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to create a reusable ReportHeader component so that I can consistently display report metadata across different views
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Component accepts date prop in standard format
  - [ ] Component accepts sampleSize prop as number
  - [ ] Component implements required styling
  - [ ] Component is properly typed
  - [ ] Component renders without errors
  - [ ] Unit tests are written and passing

### Add Report Header Documentation
- **Story:** As a developer, I want documentation for the ReportHeader component so that I can properly implement it in other areas
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 1
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Component props are documented
  - [ ] Usage examples are provided
  - [ ] Styling customization options are documented
  - [ ] Dependencies are listed
  - [ ] Documentation is added to the component library


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: API response times < 200ms
- Security: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines
- Scalability: Support horizontal scaling
